'''Sakinomiya Shrine''' (さきのみやじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Suwa, Nagano|en|Suwa, Nagano|qid=Q846338|lt=Suwa City}}, Nagano Prefecture, Japan.

== Overview ==
[[File:先宮神社 - Sakinomiya Shrine 03.jpg|thumb|180px|right|The Shrine Building and the Keyaki Tree (designated as a Suwa City {{ill|Natural monument|en|Natural monument|qid=Q23790|lt=Natural Monument}}<ref>[https://www.city.suwa.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/2152.html Cultural Property Division - Suwa City] See related file "List of Cultural Properties."</ref>) ]]
The shrine is associated with a legend involving {{ill|Takeminakata|es|Takeminakata|hu|Takeminakata|id|Takeminakata|ja|タケミナカタ|mni|ꯇꯀꯦꯃꯤꯅꯀꯇ|pl|Takeminakata|zh|建御名方神|qid=Q9150391}}, the deity enshrined at {{ill|Suwa-taisha|abstract|Q218813|de|Suwa-Taisha|es|Suwa taisha|eu|Suwa taisha|fa|زیارتگاه بزرگ سووا|fr|Suwa-taisha|hu|Szuva templom|id|Kuil Suwa|it|Santuario di Suwa (Sohonsha)|ja|諏訪大社|ko|스와 대사|lt|Suvos maldykla|pl|Suwa Taisha|ru|Сува-тайся|simple|Suwa-taisha|tr|Suwa-taisha|zh|諏訪大社|qid=Q218813|lt=Suwa-taisha}}. When Takeminakata arrived in Suwa, a conflict ensued with the local Yamato clan. After their defeat, the Yamato clan promised not to leave the Daimon area and vowed not to build a bridge over the small stream in front of the shrine. Like other shrines in the {{ill|Suwa Region|ja|諏訪地域}}, the corners of the worship hall (haiden) are adorned with {{ill|Onbashira|en|Onbashira|qid=Q3698846|lt=Onbashira}} poles.
[[File:先宮神社 - Sakinomiya Shrine 01.jpg|thumb|180px|right|The Chozuya on the right]]

== Deities ==
The main deity enshrined is {{ill|Takateruhime no Mikoto|ja|高光姫命}}.<ref>[http://www.8tree.com/sakinomiya/ Sakinomiya Shrine - Homepage]{{Broken link|date=2024th year 10月}}</ref>

== location ==
The shrine is located at:
* Daimon 3-18-1, Suwa City, Nagano Prefecture, Japan.

== Access ==
The shrine is approximately 1 kilometer north of JR {{ill|Kami-Suwa Station|en|Kami-Suwa Station|qid=Q844049|lt=Kamisuwa Station}}.
